items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Phil had made a record where Stanley Reitsman played an intro on a record. Well Stanley was kind of famous, I don’t know. And he wanted to do that number, and he wanted that intro, just like Stanley played it

ctx.x: But my first show on “The Phil Harris Show,” I mean this was live, well I guess I should interpolate, there was tape, and Alice used to tape her numbers, Alice Faye, because she didn’t want to deal with that. We taped it. I guess she performed it though, during the show, but they had a tape of it that they could splice in there, if she didn’t like what she did, being broadcast. Now the first show I come on and the very first thing on the air, no announcements, “The Phil Harris Show,” Phil had made a record where…
